And this last quarter, as we said in the prepared remarks, we added two very significant CSPs to the Spectrum-X adoption.
I'm very proud of the team.
We now have multiple significant growth engines.
Inference, once the lighter workload is surging with revenue generating AI services.
AI is growing faster and will be larger than any platform shifts before, including the internet, mobile and cloud.
Training demand continues to rise with breakthroughs in post training and like reinforcement learning and synthetic data generation.
Reasoning AI agents require orders of magnitude more compute.
Industrial AI from training to digital twin simulation to deployment, NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac GR00T are powering next-generation factories and humanoid robotic systems worldwide.
Join us at GTC Paris, our keynote at VivaTech on June 11, talking about quantum GPU computing, robotic factories and robots and celebrate our partnerships building AI factories across the region.
See you in Paris.
